facts.fact: Windsurf is an agentic AI coding IDE, formerly Codeium, that is now owned by Cognition and rebranded as Devin Desktop; windsurf.com/pricing 308-redirects to devin.ai/pricing.
facts.quote: Windsurf is an agentic AI coding IDE, formerly Codeium, now owned by Cognition and rebranded Devin Desktop, with windsurf.com/pricing 308-redirecting to devin.ai/pricing.

facts.fact: Windsurf's Pro plan is priced at $20 per month (page's 2026 pricing).
facts.quote: Pro at $20 per month, Max at $200 per month

facts.fact: Windsurf's Max plan is priced at $200 per month (page's 2026 pricing).
facts.quote: Max at $200 per month, a Teams plan at $80 per month plus $40 per full dev seat

facts.fact: Windsurf's Teams plan is priced at $80 per month plus $40 per full dev seat (page's 2026 pricing).
facts.unit: USD per month plus USD per seat
facts.quote: a Teams plan at $80 per month plus $40 per full dev seat

facts.fact: Windsurf offers a free tier priced at $0 (page's 2026 pricing).
Windsurf's Enterprise tier is custom-quoted rather than listed at a fixed price.
Each paid Windsurf plan includes a usage quota that refreshes on a daily and weekly basis.
facts.quote: Each paid plan includes a usage quota that refreshes on a daily and weekly basis

facts.fact: Usage beyond Windsurf's included quota is purchased at underlying model API pricing rather than a flat per-message fee.
facts.quote: Usage beyond the included quota is purchased at underlying model API pricing rather than a flat per-message fee.

facts.fact: Per the page, in 2026 Windsurf replaced its Cascade prompt-credit system with daily and weekly quotas and raised Pro from $15 to $20, which drew public user backlash.
facts.quote: In 2026 Windsurf replaced its long-running Cascade prompt-credit system with daily and weekly quotas and raised Pro from $15 to $20

facts.fact: Per the page, Windsurf's ownership split in July 2025 after OpenAI's $3 billion acquisition collapsed: Google paid $2.4 billion to hire the founders and Cognition bought the remaining company.
facts.quote: Windsurf's ownership split in July 2025 when OpenAI's $3 billion acquisition collapsed, Google paid $2.4 billion to hire the founders, and Cognition bought the remaining company.
